{{Quote|Enna Tabord, a member of our Order, is already on the surface looking for Krannus.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Anarchy" />}}
'''Enna Tabord''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the Order learned of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] plans to annihilate all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] through a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]], the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] sent Tabord to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] to investigate what the Imperial [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]] was doing on the world. However, Tabord was attacked by an Imperial patrol while scouting the area after an [[Invasion of Belsavis|Imperial attack]] freed many of the prisoners, and she was barely able to inform the unofficial prison guard [[Pak Taldine]] of her findings before her [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|She crawled back from her scouting mission, wounded and barely alive. Said she escaped from an Imperial patrol. I tried to help her, but I'm not a med-tech.|Pak Taldine|<ref name="Anarchy" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Enna Tabord was recruited into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Anarchy" /> at some point before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3641 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] learned from [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], the former [[Emperor's Wrath]] who had betrayed the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to aid the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], that the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] intended to perform a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]] that would allow him to consume all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="An Unthinkable Alliance">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|An Unthinkable Alliance|the Emperor's Fortress}}</ref> [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] immediately began searching for signs of Imperial activity. Upon learning that the Empire had launched an [[Invasion of Belsavis|attack]] on the secret [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] as part of the [[Galactic War]], the Grand Master also discovered evidence that a high-ranking servant of the Emperor named [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]] had arrived on Belsavis. Shan dispatched Tabord to investigate before informing the Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and Scourge, and Tabord arrived on Belsavis not long into the riots that resulted from the Imperial attack.<ref name="Anarchy" />

She made contact with the prison's administration and acquired the aid of a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] named [[Pak Taldine]], who had been incarcerated on Belsavis for a series of murders many years earlier but had reformed and become an unofficial member of the prison guard. Taldine's knowledge of Belsavis was unrivaled among the guards, and Tabord used his help to locate Krannus's forces on the western edge of the [[Minimum Security Section]]. As the Hero had not yet arrived, Tabord decided to scout out the area herself and departed the [[Republic Guardpost Beta]]. However, she was surprised to find the Imperials holed up in the [[South Power Generator Facility]] in the western cliffs with heavy weaponry and a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]], and the Jedi was severely injured when an Imperial patrol discovered her before she could slip away.<ref name="Anarchy" />

Tabord was able to make it back to the guardpost and described her encounter to Taldine before [[Death/Legends|dying]], including the presence of a [[Sith (species)/Legends|red-skinned]] Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who seemed to match the description of Krannus. Mere [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] after her death, the Hero arrived with a companion, but Taldine was convinced to help the Jedi act on Tabord's information. With the intelligence Tabord gathered, the Hero was able to shut down the facility's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and [[Mission to Belsavis (Emperor's ritual crisis)|storm]] the base, although Krannus had already departed by that [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Anarchy" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Enna_Tabord.png|thumb|right|180px|Enna Tabord's corpse]]
{{Quote|Even with an entire army; they don't stand a chance against a Jedi.''"<br />"''That's what Enna thought.|The Hero of Tython and Pak Taldine|<ref name="Anarchy" />}}
Fair-skinned with short [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Enna Tabord was overconfident when it came to her Jedi abilities&mdash;something that led to her death at the hands of an Imperial patrol. However, she was determined to finish her mission even after she was injured, and she found the strength to make it back to the guardpost so that her information could be of use. As a Jedi, Tabord wore green combat [[Clothing/Legends|apparel]] with grey-and-white [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and she kept her hair cut short.<ref name="Anarchy" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|She'll help you find the Executor. But she isn't strong enough to stop him&mdash;that task falls on you.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Anarchy" />}}
Tabord was Force-sensitive and strong enough with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that she was accepted into the Jedi Order, but her powers were relatively weak compared to some of her contemporaries; Tabord was unable to defend herself against an Imperial patrol. Tabord wielded a single-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in combat.<ref name="Anarchy" />

==Behind the scenes==
Enna Tabord first appeared briefly in the Jedi Knight mission "Anarchy" on Belsavis in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The player is instructed to locate Tabord upon arriving on Belsavis but instead finds Taldine standing over the Jedi's body in the guardpost, where they were supposed to meet. A glitch occasionally shows Tabord standing at the beginning of the cutscene, though she immediately reverts to lying on the floor and remains there throughout the conversation.<ref name="Anarchy" />
